text: Please accept this letter as my request to add a new item of business to the April 2018 Scarborough Community Council agenda which asks staff to report on the feasibility of installing an All-Way Stop Control at Bernadine Street at Doerr Road. I would like to move the motion below that would create a safer environment for the pedestrians and drivers of the local community by requesting that: Staff report back to the June 2018 Scarborough Community Council with a report on the feasibility of installing an All-Way Stop Control at Bernadine Street at Doerr Road. If you have any questions regarding this matter, please feel free to contact me at 416-392-0204.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Requested the Director, Transportation Services, Scarborough District to report to the June 6, 2018 meeting of Scarborough Community Council on the feasibility of installing an All-way Stop Control at Bernadine Street and Doerr Road.
